notes.manas-2010:p0460:b001:l004: Кайкалаган proud/upright bearing; not an actual enthronement accomplished in this speech.
notes.manas-2010:p0460:b001:l006: Тилге салып with/by words and obedience; coercive or diplomatic mechanism unspecified.
notes.manas-2010:p0460:b001:l009: Кынжыла- collar/muzzle a beast, metaphor of submission; dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/кын/. Not confuse кынжыл- fret.
notes.manas-2010:p0460:b001:l012: Колума in my hands broad possession/support image; no kidnapping added.
notes.manas-2010:p0460:b001:l020: Туйгун hawk epithet retained, not separate bird entering narrative.

notes.manas-2010:p0460:b001:l027: Visible Кечүүдөн алган көчүмдү is awkward caravan/crossing fragment. Literal lexical reading retained; not silently changed to revenge/өчүм.
notes.manas-2010:p0460:b001:l029: Кеңири башым free/unconstrained existence, not literally large skull.
notes.manas-2010:p0460:b001:l038: Караандуу formidable/conspicuous man scouting; friend versus foe left unspecified.
notes.manas-2010:p0460:b001:l041: Бейпай struggle/trouble in combat context: Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/бейпай/.
notes.manas-2010:p0461:b001:l005: Бел waist/ridge repeated; broad ridge they rely upon contextual terrain reading; possible figurative backing remains.
notes.manas-2010:p0461:b001:l007: English supplies against to connect object Manas to explicit Chinese subject of following invasion clause; source case/syntax abrupt.
notes.manas-2010:p0461:b001:l014: Evidential conjecture -дыр retained as must have throughout conjectural siege passage.
notes.manas-2010:p0461:b001:l023: Аба elder/uncle respectful kin address, not asserted biological uncle.
notes.manas-2010:p0461:b001:l025: Көөнү келсе if it comes to mind/heart retained with conditional; not independent certainty of distress.
notes.manas-2010:p0461:b001:l035: Карып exiles/wretched people, not simply old age; Akbaltay and Jakyp explicitly named.
notes.manas-2010:p0461:b001:l039: Born from among those people captures plural ошолодон without assigning both named men as biological fathers.
notes.manas-2010:p0462:b001:l002: Kyrgyz-Burut dual ethnonym retained; without making them ask renders суратпай.
notes.manas-2010:p0462:b001:l004: Мээ brain/mind image retained as guiding mind; бел previous page support/backbone.

notes.manas-2010:p0462:b001:l029: Улугу арбын кеби бар syntactically uncertain; many rulers have their say preserves rulers/many/speech without inventing titles.
notes.manas-2010:p0462:b001:l034: Кылым broad whole peoples/ages hyperbole; no exact duration assigned.
notes.manas-2010:p0462:b001:l038: Ulukman retained as printed potential name; not silently equated to Luqman the physician or generic great leader.
